purpose: 序篇第一話前三頁；待使用者驗收，不代表整話完成
prompts:
Use case: illustration-story. ORIGINAL HERO FRONTIER full-color manga, ONE landscape 16:9 comic page about 2048x1152. Actual sequential manga, 5 unequal panels, clear LEFT TO RIGHT/TOP TO BOTTOM reading. Bold expressive clean ink outlines, hand-drawn handsome mature characters, detailed painterly fantasy environments, rich color cel shading, dramatic close-ups and varied shot sizes. Thin cream gutters and dark panel borders, NOT slideshow, NOT game UI, NOT text column next to one illustration. Readable horizontal Traditional Chinese speech balloons with tails correctly pointing to speakers, no writing beyond specified dialogue/captions/title; no English, watermarks, panel numbers. Mood warm, engaging, lived-in, humane, not solemn exposition. No war or villain. This is the peaceful historical period BEFORE modern playable heroes: ONLY ordinary unnamed people, no royalty, no recognizable main heroes. Consistent recurring ordinary cast: human dock carpenter age40, short chestnut hair, short beard, faded BLUE rolled-sleeve shirt and TAN leather apron, square sturdy face (NOT gold-armored hero); Silverleaf MALE caravan hand, pointed ears, long CHESTNUT hair tied halfway back, GREEN cloak with leaf clasp and ivory tunic, leather work gloves, gentle green eyes; Shadowfolk FEMALE civilian mage, pale skin, WHITE shoulder-length hair, VIOLET eyes, deep PURPLE hood lowered behind head, silver-trimmed robe, NO daggers/armor (not the named rogue heroine). Plain cloth goods crate has two iron bands and blue fabric corner. Human stone riverside market + natural green wooded hills + simple timber docks. No exact years, no ancient soul magic, no ancestry claims. Match these character identities and costumes in every panel. Text very legible black Traditional Chinese, generous white balloon padding, do not obscure faces/hands. Scene should act out collaboration without turning it into a history lecture.
PAGE 1 of an opening episode. Title small 「曾經的和平」, subtitle 「第一話・同一條路」. 5 panels with large wide opening top panel, two medium middle panels, two bottom panels with last wider. Panel1: wide river valley marketplace with human boats and a Silverleaf wagon arriving; ordinary people exchanging goods, no established grand shared city yet. Short cream narration box 「在城牆分開我們以前，商路曾把彼此連在一起。」 Panel2: close hands open wagon's crate showing metal tools; Silverleaf man checks an iron hinge and smiles at human carpenter: 「這批工具，是你們做的？」 Panel3: human carpenter smiles and taps the ironwork, beside crates to deliver, balloon 「是。木料送到了，就能一起開工。」 Panel4: heavy banded crate on awkward narrow timber unloading ramp, human carpenter and Silverleaf man pause before lifting; mage approaches to help, weight strain but no injury. Carpenter says 「等等，這樣抬，木板會撐不住。」 Panel5: three at the ramp, mage kneels examining support joint rather than fighting, points to it while carpenter and Silverleaf look; her speech 「先別急。我可以幫忙。」 Last expression anticipates next page, no montage of finished city. Show concrete action progression. All speech text exactly specified.

PAGE 2 of same opening, title small 「各有所長」. Same three unnamed ordinary civilians in same clothes, next moment at the timber unloading ramp, same heavy banded tools crate. Five dynamic panels: top row 2 panels, bottom row3, final largest. Panel1 medium shot human carpenter kneels and slides a timber brace under ramp; Shadowfolk mage holds the crate subtly hovering just a few centimeters with gentle violet geometric SUPPORT spell (ordinary helpful magic, NOT black magic). Carpenter bubble 「我來加固下面。」 Panel2 Silverleaf man firmly guides taut loading rope around solid timber dockpost; cloak folded clear of his hands, precise grip; his bubble 「繩索交給我。」 Panel3 close-up mage's focused violet eyes and open gloved palm, gentle violet glow visible under the SAME crate, one bubble 「抬高一點……現在！」 Panel4 energetic three-quarter view carpenter and Silverleaf guiding crate together up the now-supported ramp, mage controlling lift; nobody wears armor, no duplicates, coherent physical poses, two small balloons correctly tailed: carpenter 「往左！」 Silverleaf 「接住了！」 Panel5 satisfying larger wide: crate safely settled ON dock beside workshop, all three releasing effort, human laughs relieved, Silverleaf wiping brow and mage lowers palm as glow fades; small bubble carpenter 「好了，一件也沒摔壞！」 no concluding moral narration, the success itself shows their complementary skills. Bright warm daylight and visual relief.

PAGE 3 of same opening, title small 「下一趟，也一起走」. Five panels, top row2, bottomrow3 with emotional last wide. Immediately after successful cargo unloading, same river marketplace and same three characters. Panel1 close-up carpenter's weathered hand counts a few ordinary silver coins into his palm, no ornate symbols/currency branding, tools crate visible behind; carpenter bubble off-panel 「今天的工錢，三個人一起分。」 Panel2 medium conversational shot Shadowfolk mage surprised and smiling subtly, hand raised modestly, Silverleaf listening: mage 「我只是順手幫忙。」 Panel3 close-up human carpenter gentle sincere face, blue sleeve and tan apron visible, answering 「少了你，我們還卡在岸邊呢。」 Panel4 Silverleaf man points toward his wagon and wooden tools packed for next journey, hopeful expression; bubble 「下次送貨，也一起來吧？」 Panel5 biggest wide warm composition: three ordinary workers walk toward the same wagon chatting companionably, mixed people trading in background, water glints, no royal palace yet. Mage turns toward companions and replies 「好。這次換我帶路。」 Small unobtrusive narration box 「最初的傭兵，是受雇來幫忙的人。」 This is a modest agreement to work together, NOT a military mercenary recruitment, no weapon raising. Genuine heartwarming expressions without overdramatic poses. No new lore or extra captions.
